title: Zscaler log types and where they land in a SIEM

prose.text: Zscaler defines the log types and their fields; where the records land in a SIEM, and under what names, is the tenant's own configuration. This catalog covers the first half and says what vendor sources state about the second.

rows: ZIA Tunnel and the other ZIA feed types
ZPA Private Service Edge status and metrics

prose.text: The full list of ZPA log types and their codes is [[zpa.log-receivers.log-types]]. Whether one receiver carries one log type or several is not settled {{gap:receiver-log-types}}.

prose.heading: What vendor sources say about SIEMs

prose.text: {{cloud-siem-guides}} {{vm-siem-guides}} The Cloud NSS feed names its SIEM type, with OAuth fields for Azure Sentinel: [[zia.api.cloud-nss-feeds:oauth-fields]].

prose.label: Splunk.
prose.text: {{splunk-example}} Name-value output, which Splunk can parse without a fixed order: [[shared.splunk:name-value-pairs]]. Other Splunk names, including add-on defaults and ZPA indexes, are tenant data {{gap:splunk-landing}}.

prose.label: Other SIEMs.
prose.text: Table, log-type and index names in Sentinel, Google SecOps, Elastic and Sumo Logic are tenant data {{gap:other-siem-landing}}.

checks.do: Ask the operator, or read the SIEM, for the index, sourcetype, table or log type each Zscaler log type lands in before writing a query.
For a Cloud NSS feed, read the feed's output format: a JSON envelope can set the SIEM-side name itself.

splunk-example.statement: The Terraform provider's Cloud NSS feed examples wrap each record in a JSON envelope that names a Splunk sourcetype: the example headed NSS Splunk Feed is a `WEBLOG` feed with siem_type `SPLUNK` and sourcetype `zscalernss-web`, and the example headed NSS Splunk Feed - Google Chronicle is an `FWLOG` feed with siem_type `SPLUNK`, a Google Chronicle connection URL and sourcetype `zscalernss-fw`.

splunk-landing.title: Splunk sourcetypes and indexes for each Zscaler log type
splunk-landing.detail: Unverified legacy statement: Splunk add-on default sourcetypes "zscalernss-web", "zscalernss-fw", "zscalernss-dns" and "zscalernss-alerts", with common short forms such as "nss-web", "zscaler-web", "zia-web" (and the -fw, -dns forms), "nss-tunnel", "nss-casb"; for ZPA "no TA default; tenant-configured", with common names such as "lss-zpa-activity", "zpa-user-activity", "zscalerlss-zpa", "lss-zpa-status", "lss-zpa-connector", "zpa-browser-access", "lss-zpa-audit". Of these only zscalernss-web and zscalernss-fw appear in a vendor source, as sourcetypes set inside example feed output formats, not as an add-on contract.

other-siem-landing.title: Table, log-type and index names in other SIEMs
other-siem-landing.detail: Unverified legacy statement: Sentinel tables "ZScalerEvent" or "ZscalerWeb_CL" for ZIA and "ZPAEvent" or "ZscalerZPA_CL" for ZPA; Chronicle log types "ZSCALER_WEBPROXY", "ZSCALER_FIREWALL", "ZSCALER_DNS", "ZSCALER_ZPA" or "ZPA_USER_ACTIVITY"; Elastic index patterns "logs-zscaler.web-*", "logs-zscaler.firewall-*", "logs-zscaler.dns-*", "logs-zscaler.zpa-*" or "zscaler-nss-*"; Sumo Logic source categories "zscaler/web", "zscaler/firewall", "zscaler/dns", "zscaler/zpa/activity". No captured vendor source names any of them; the legacy doc itself said they vary by connector, parser or agent version and by tenant.

uncaptured-feed-fields.title: Field lists for ZIA feed types other than Web, Firewall and DNS
uncaptured-feed-fields.detail: Unverified legacy statement: the ZIA Tunnel feed "carries Z-Tunnel / GRE / IPsec session events: tunnel up/down, peer info, traffic forwarding state" and its schema is "not yet documented". The General Guidelines list output-format articles for Tunnel, SaaS Security Activity, Endpoint DLP, Email DLP, Sandbox Verdict, Authentication, SCIM, 3rd-Party App Governance and Posture Management logs, but only the Web, Firewall and DNS field lists are captured as types; SaaS Security and admin audit fields are open in their own subjects.
uncaptured-feed-fields.blocks: naming fields or writing queries for those feeds

receiver-log-types.title: Whether one ZPA log receiver carries one log type or several
receiver-log-types.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Each LSS log type is a separate feed configured in the ZPA admin UI." The receiver configuration carries a single sourceLogType (zpa.log-receivers.configuration:config-fields), while the Log Streaming Service page says a log receiver can capture several log types.

quotes: A log receiver can capture several log types.
